name: matterhorn-window
description: A 256×256 rectangle of real SRTM1 data around the Matterhorn, cut byte-for-byte out of the source tile. Same format as a .hgt file, but a window rather than a whole degree, so its geometry is written down here instead of derived from the file length.

source.dataset: SRTM1 (1 arc-second) via the AWS elevation-tiles-prod "skadi" mirror
source.license: SRTM is public domain (NASA/USGS); the AWS mirror is a public dataset.

statistics.note: voidSamples is 0 because the skadi mirror is void-filled — verified across N45E007, N46E007, N27E086, N28E086 (0 voids in 51 868 804 samples). The void code path is covered by the synthetic fixtures instead.

accuracyCaveat: SRTM under-reads AND displaces sharp summits: the highest posting here is 4230 m against the Matterhorn's surveyed 4478 m, and it sits ~320 m WSW of the surveyed summit position (which itself reads 3567 m, already down the east side). Use these tiles for the terrain horizon; take summit heights from the peak database's ele tag.
